publisher: Directorio de Transporte Público Metropolitano (DTPM), Chile
title: Reporte de Movilidad 2025

scope.geography: 34 communes of Gran Santiago; not Santiago comuna alone

findings.finding: Restricted zone-household-person sampling; random among persons present at home. 412 valid interviews; 76% conducted Tuesday-Friday 13:00–19:00; expansion/correction by socioeconomic level, sex and age.

Participants over 12 across 34 communes. The 12–20 age bin contains 46 records; this bin cannot isolate ages 14–18 or current secondary students. Media=158 describes achieved educational level, not current school stage. Published age table labels the next bin 40–45; retain as printed, do not silently correct.
Final results fuse EM2025, EOD2012 and TELCO. Study-purpose journeys include all educational levels; cannot substitute for new high-school-specific travel observations.
Report recommends increasing sample to 1200 households and improving interview schedules and short-trip measurement.

admission_decision: Context evidence only; preserve Santiago missing/high-school uncertainty bounds unchanged. No new high-school point estimate or interval is derived.
prior_eod2012_questionnaire_status: Unresolved: no new original questionnaire verified for Estudios/Curso current-versus-completed interpretation. EM2025 attainment table does not resolve distinct EOD2012 variables.
microdata_search_status: No released respondent microdata link located in bounded official-site search; this is not a proof that microdata do not exist.
